title: Sync, alarm, movies and a smarter AI DJ

items.text: Sync with another phone: your liked songs and playlists stay the same on Android and iPhone (Settings → Sync with another phone).
Alarm: wake up to your liked songs, a playlist or a For You mix (Settings → Alarm).
New song alerts: a notification when a singer you listen to releases a new song.
Automatic updates: new versions download and install on their own while you aren't using the app.
Movies: browse Indian films by language and decade, with music director and cast. Search a film's name to play its whole album in order.
AI DJ: talk to it like a person ("sad Punjabi songs", then "only Arijit" or "no remix"). Now powered by Google Gemini, and it plays only songs that really exist.
Search in Hindi or Punjabi script, by typing or by voice.
Share a song as a link that opens straight in Sangeet.
Pahadi songs: Garhwali, Kumaoni and Himachali music in a new category.
For You, radio and the AI DJ now learn from what all Sangeet listeners play. Sharing is anonymous and can be turned off in Settings → Help improve suggestions.
For You and radio now learn from what other Sangeet listeners play.
Moods (Happy, Sad, Party and more) now play songs that truly fit the mood, not songs that only have the word in their name.
Importing YouTube and YouTube Music playlists works again.
YouTube songs play more reliably.
Songs you search for now play whatever their language, followed by similar songs.
Report a problem sends reports again.
Wrapped: your year in music as a card to share (Library → Your Stats).
Blend: one playlist made from your taste and a friend's.
Share a line from the lyrics as a picture (press and hold a lyrics line).
Car mode: big buttons in Now Playing.
New from your singers on Home.
More songs: the catalogue now grows three times a day (over 12 lakh songs).
Download songs to play without internet, and save them to Files.
Liquid Glass look (Settings → Look).
YouTube in the background (experimental, Settings).
Voice search, and search by a line from the lyrics.
Recent searches in the search bar.
A song you pick from search is followed by similar songs.
Haryanvi Badmashi category.
Liquid Glass theme, in light and dark.
Search by singer's name; lock screen and Dynamic Island controls.
The clock and battery icons at the top now stay readable in every theme.
